Life ExtractionPassive
Winnex grants self [Consolidation II] for 2 turns whenever an ally dies and restores self HP by 36% of Max HP whenever an ally is revived.
Call of the UnderworldActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Revives the selected ally with 20% of their Max HP if they die, allowing the ally to act immediately, and resets the cooldowns of all their skills. The revived ally dies immediately after acting. Increases the ATK of the selected target by 40% for 2 turns and grants them [DMG Immunity] for 1 turn if they are not dead. The cooldown of this skill cannot be reduced or increased by other effects.
Underworld Utensils Lv.1Targets revived by Call of the Underworld have a 20% chance to not die after acting. This effect triggers every time after the target acts until the target or Winnex dies.
Underworld Utensils Lv.3If there is a dead ally, Winnex additionally casts Call of the Underworld on the ally when he acts. This skill only takes effect 1 time in each wave.
